Membership landing intro: AB2TI membership is association membership. Visitors can apply without creating an account.
Membership is not cooperative membership: AB2TI membership is not the same as Koperasi Pusat membership, and this application does not enrol you in the cooperative.
Membership apply does not create an acco: Submitting an application does not create a login account. Staff will review your application.
Submitting is not membership approval: Submitting an application does not mean you have been approved as an AB2TI member.
Membership step fill: Fill in your details. You do not need an account.
Membership step send: Submit the application. You will receive a reference code.
Membership step review: AB2TI staff review the application. Approval is not automatic.
Staff will review after you submit: After you submit, AB2TI staff will review your application.
Fill the form to apply. Documents are op: Fill this form to apply for membership. Supporting documents are optional.
Required fields are marked: Fields marked * are required. The others may be left blank.
Please check the highlighted fields: Check the highlighted fields, then submit again.
Email is for contact, not an account: We use this email to contact you. It does not create a login.
Notes are optional: Optional. For example an organisation, region, or short note.
You may attach a photo, identity documen: You may attach a photo, identity document, or payment proof if you have them.
We received your membership application. Staff will review it.
Current application state awaiting revie: Current state: submitted and awaiting staff review.
Keep this reference code for support: Keep this reference code if you need support.
Reference code is not a login or status: This code is not a login, not an edit link, and not a status tracker.
What happens next after submit: What happens next, with currently supported behaviour: staff review the application. This page does not send automatic notifications.
If you just submitted, your reference co: If you just submitted, the reference code was shown after sending. This page does not show application status.
Revise application intro: Update the requested information, then resubmit. This is not membership approval and does not create an account.
Please update the requested information: Update the information according to the staff instruction.
Replace documents only if requested: Replace attachments only if requested. Previous files remain for history.
Revision submitted body: We received your updated application. Staff must start review again before a decision.
Internal notes are not sent to the appli: These notes are for staff only. Do not write applicant instructions here.
Rejection reason is optional and applica: Optional. Use wording that could be shown to the applicant. This is not an internal note.
Revision instruction is shown to the app: The applicant will see this text. Do not include internal staff notes.
Request membership application revision: The applicant will be able to correct data through a temporary link. The application is not approved or rejected yet.
Revision link operational note: Copy this link now and send it through the organisation’s current channel. The secret is not stored as text on the server. Automatic email or WhatsApp is not available.
Revision link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy the text from the box manually.
Revision already requested: Revision is already requested. Reissue the link if the previous one was lost or must be revoked.
Reissue revision link hint: Reissuing revokes the previous link. This instruction remains visible to the applicant.
Approve membership application confirmat: This will record exactly one AB2TI Member from this application. It cannot be undone in this version. A user account will not be created.
Reject membership application confirmati: This permanently rejects the application. An AB2TI Member will not be created. The applicant must submit a new application to apply again.
Member registry intro: AB2TI members after an application is approved. This is not the application queue, and not Kartu Anggota.
Record identifier is not Kartu Anggota n: This unique identifier belongs to the member record. It is not the approved Kartu Anggota AB2TI number.
Source application is not the member rec: The application is intake history. The member is association identity after approval.
Account link unlinked help: This member is not linked to a login account. Create an invitation and deliver the URL through a trusted channel. The secret URL is shown once.
Account link invited help: An invitation exists. The secret is not stored in plaintext. Reissue if you need to send it again.
Account link linked help: This member is linked to a login account. Do not create another invitation.
Account link expired help: The previous invitation is no longer valid. Create a new one if the member still needs to link an account.
Account-link operational note: Copy now and send through a trusted channel. The system does not email this URL and does not store the secret in plaintext.
Account-link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy it manually.
Site access inactive help: This member does not yet have a website account linked to AB2TI membership.
Site access invited help: An activation invitation is available. The secret URL is not stored in plaintext. Reissue if you need to send it again.
Site access linked help: A website account is linked to this membership. Do not issue another invitation.
Site access expired help: The previous invitation is no longer valid. Create a new one if the member still needs site access.
Site account email hint: Suggested from member contact data. Change it if the login email is different. This does not change the member contact email.
Activation link operational note: Copy now and send through a trusted channel. The system does not send this URL automatically and does not store the secret in plaintext.
Activation link copy failed: Could not copy. Copy it manually from the text box.
Member site access invitation intro: You received access to use AB2TI member services. An account is not linked automatically even if the email or phone number matches.
Connect account intro: This invitation connects your login account to the AB2TI member record. Matching email or phone is not enough.
Staff cannot connect membership: Staff accounts cannot be linked to membership. Sign in with the member’s personal account.
Account already linked elsewhere: This account is already linked to another AB2TI member. One account can belong to only one member.
Account already exists: An account with this email already exists.
Account already exists help: Sign in with that account, then connect it to AB2TI membership. Matching email is not proof of ownership.
Already have an account: Already have an account? Log in
